Downpour in Quezon City on Monday afternoon (June 23, 2025), resulting in flood and heavy traffic. Photos taken along Timog Avenue and Kamuning Road. 
DOST-PAGASA said the southwest monsoon (habagat) is affecting Metro Manila, Calabarzon, Bicol Region, Mimaropa, Western Visayas, Zamboanga Peninsula, Bangsamoro, Negros Occidental and the rest of Central Luzon.  At 3 p.m. a low-pressure area was estimated based on all available data at 185 km west of Cubi Pt. at Subic Bay International Airport in Bataan. | PNA photos by Robert Oswald P. Alfiler

data.raw_text:
24 June 
Important events – 

1793 – France adopted the Republican Constitution for the first time.

1812 – French dictator Napoleon Bonaparte invaded Russia with an army of three and a half lakhs.

1904 – Harris gave voice to Baloo of The Jungle Book and Little John of Robin Hood.

1918 – The first airmail service started in Canada between Montreal and Toronto.

1947 – Shah Alami (Lahore) was set on fire by Muslims, RSS volunteers risked their lives to protect Hindus.

1961 – India’s first indigenous HF 24 supersonic fighter aircraft took off.

1963 – The Post and Telegraph Department started the National Telex Service.

1986 – The Government of India announced that unmarried mothers will also get maternity leave under its employment scheme.

 1989 - Majority opposition members resigned from Lok Sabha on the issue of CAG report on Bofors gun deal.

1990 - Defence scientists successfully tested the country's first third generation anti-tank missile 'NAG'.

2005 - US recognizes India's claim for permanent membership in the Security Council.

2006 - Death penalty abolished in Philippines.

2007 - Iraqi High Tribunal sentenced three people including Saddam Hussein's cousin Ali Hassan Al Majid alias Chemical Ali to death.

Birthday

1863 - Famous Indian writer, historian, best speaker and scholar Vishwanath Kashinath Rajwade was born.

1869 - Damodar Hari Chaphekar, one of the revolutionary immortal martyrs of India, was born.

1885 - Famous politician and staunch Sikh leader Tara Singh was born.

 1897 - Famous educationist, musician and Hindustani classical singer Omkarnath Thakur was born.

Death anniversary

1564 - Rani Durgavati, one of the famous warrior queens of Indian history, was martyred.

1881- Pandit Shraddharam Sharma, the composer of 'Om Jai Jagdish Hare' Aarti and famous Hindi, Punjabi writer and freedom fighter, died.

1980 - India's fourth President V.V. Giri died.

Important days -

Veerangana Rani Durgavati Balidan Diwas
